handover_report.title: EverythingAI / EverythingApp — June 1 Consolidated Local MVP Hardening Validated Handover
handover_report.prepared_for: Next AI engineering agent / continuation session

repository.name: everythingAI
repository.working_branch_policy: All work happens directly on main unless the user explicitly changes this rule.

executive_summary.project_identity: EverythingAI is a local-first, source-backed AI knowledge workspace and file intelligence platform. It indexes scoped local files, extracts content, builds durable knowledge/wiki views, generates governed planning suggestions, and supports safe file organization through preview, approval, execution, audit, recovery, and undo workflows.
executive_summary.current_state: Local MVP hardening is validated on main through provider planning, backend planning-rule enforcement, Undo UI, Knowledge page, Knowledge wiki detail view, AnythingLLM sync control, source-path watcher resume, planning-rule feedback UI, provider-aware planning sessions, and provider-specific error metadata.
executive_summary.latest_validation_result: Backend npm test passed with 106 tests, 106 pass, 0 fail. Frontend npm run typecheck passed. Frontend npm run build passed with 1544 modules transformed.
executive_summary.recommended_next_focus: Run a manual Windows local smoke test for source path add/pause/resume/remove after backend restart, then update ROADMAP.md and begin controlled frontend modularization of AppEnhanced.tsx.

major_validated_milestones.name: Phase 7.6 Governance & Trust Visibility
major_validated_milestones.summary: Workspace Trust Health, Knowledge Quality Scoring, Human Validation, Review Coverage, Governance Conflict Dashboard, Review Candidate Dashboard, and conflict/review badges are complete without changing trust-score or quality-score calculations.

major_validated_milestones.name: Provider planning suggestions
major_validated_milestones.summary: Configured provider planning suggestions support deterministic, provider, and hybrid modes with deterministic fallback, safe normalization, constrained action types, and regression coverage.

major_validated_milestones.name: Backend planning-rule enforcement
major_validated_milestones.summary: Configured suggestions enforce confidenceThreshold, allowRename, allowMove, allowTag, allowCategory, requireApproval, and dryRunOnly behavior.

major_validated_milestones.name: Provider-aware planning sessions
major_validated_milestones.summary: Planning-session routes and UI can create and run deterministic, provider, and hybrid sessions while preserving deterministic compatibility.

major_validated_milestones.name: Undo UI
major_validated_milestones.summary: Planning and Analytics views expose execution history and guarded Undo actions using existing backend undo APIs.

major_validated_milestones.name: Knowledge page and wiki detail view
major_validated_milestones.summary: Knowledge page displays classifications, entities, duplicate groups, generated wiki pages, source-backed wiki detail content, and source references when present.

major_validated_milestones.name: AnythingLLM sync UI
major_validated_milestones.summary: Knowledge page includes a guarded AnythingLLM sync trigger using server-side integration settings so credentials remain backend-side.

major_validated_milestones.name: Source-path watcher resume
major_validated_milestones.summary: Backend startup resumes persisted active watchers, ignores stopped roots, reports failed roots, and marks missing roots as failed.

major_validated_milestones.name: Provider-specific error feedback
major_validated_milestones.summary: Provider unavailable responses now include provider_error_code and provider_error_hint while preserving provider_status and provider_error. Regression tests cover remote policy blocks, missing API keys, and HTTP authorization failures.

frontend_build.evidence: vite build completed successfully with 1544 modules transformed and build completed in 2.12 seconds.

governance_and_safety_invariants_preserv: Work remained directly on main branch.
Human validation remains separate from quality scoring.
AI validation does not outweigh human validation.
Diagnostics payload backward compatibility was preserved.
Provider-backed suggestions remain reviewable and constrained to safe action types.
Filesystem mutations still require backend preview/execution controls.
Undo remains explicit and user-confirmed in UI flows.
Remote provider policy remains enforced and was not relaxed.
Provider error metadata was added without removing existing provider_status/provider_error fields.
Source-path watcher failures do not abort all remaining persisted watcher resumes.
current_capabilities: Dashboard, Explorer, Planning, Knowledge, Analytics, and Settings in the enhanced React UI.
Local source-path scope management with add, pause, resume, remove, re-scan, and persisted backend scope.
Backend-persisted source paths with startup watcher resume.
Indexing, extraction, embeddings, insights, search, and durable wiki/knowledge generation foundation.
Configurable provider settings, model discovery, and remote-provider policy gating.
Provider-backed chat, insights, and planning foundation.
Planning-rule enforcement with UI feedback for active rules and blocked previews.
Dry-run preview queue, guarded execution, audit trail, recovery snapshots, and undo.
Knowledge page with classifications, entities, duplicate groups, wiki pages, wiki detail view, and source references.
AnythingLLM sync control from the Knowledge page.
Provider-specific error codes and hints for clearer troubleshooting.

known_limitations_and_followups: Manual Windows smoke test is still recommended for source path add/pause/resume/remove after backend restart.
Manual watcher behavior should be verified by adding a new file into a watched folder after backend restart and confirming indexing updates.
ROADMAP.md should be patched to mark the validated local MVP hardening milestones complete.
AppEnhanced.tsx is now dense and should be modularized in controlled frontend-only steps with typecheck/build after every extraction.
Provider error metadata exists in backend responses, but future UI polish can surface provider_error_code and provider_error_hint more visibly wherever provider failures are displayed.
AnythingLLM end-to-end sync depends on valid ANYTHINGLLM_BASE_URL, ANYTHINGLLM_API_KEY, and optionally ANYTHINGLLM_WORKSPACE_SLUG on the backend environment.

startup_instructions_for_next_agent: Read this handover first before making changes.
Then inspect the specific file/handover for the area being changed.
Preserve governance invariants and backward compatibility.
Do not change trust-score or quality-score calculations unless explicitly requested and separately governed.
After backend changes, run npm test in services/api.
After frontend changes, run npm run typecheck and npm run build in apps/everything-ai-ui.
Do not pop the user's local stash unless the package-lock changes are intentionally reviewed.
